title: His parents' names and work
summary: His mother was Swiss-descended, born in Manhattan; his German father was a florist in Nyack.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Shall we digress and get into that or shall we continue where we are?
It might help to stick to where we are for the time being. We'll have to make sure you get into that. One thing before we go any further, what were your parents' names?
My mother's name was Julia Groeter, it was Swiss; and my
father's name was August Sauter; he was German.
What did they do for a living?

My father was a florist, he had greenhouses in Nyack. I guess before that he came to this country as a landscape gardener. He had done that in France, in England and in Switzerland. This goes back into the nineteenth century.
Were they both born in Europe?
No, my mother was born in Manhattan, of Swiss parentage.
When did your father come here?
1890; something like that. It must have been because they were well established by the time of the Gold Rush of 1898.
